strings.jp:
常識を覆す彼女の無茶苦茶な戦いぶりは
敵のみならず、味方の度肝も抜いた
そうだ…
strings.en:
Her wild fighting, defying all
common sense, stunned not
only her foes but her own allies,
too...

strings.jp:
己の人生も省みずに不慣れな軍人の道を
歩んだその可憐な少女の姿に
人々は涙したという…
strings.en:
People wept at the sight of the
lovely girl who, heedless of her
own life, walked the unfamiliar
path of a soldier...

strings.jp:
己の安全を省みぬ無謀なまでの
彼女の勇気が周囲を勇気付ける
こともあったという…
strings.en:
Her courage, reckless to the
point of ignoring her own
safety, at times gave courage
to those around her...

strings.jp:
その決して逆境にも挫けることのない
彼女の強き精神が仲間たちを励まし
皆を勇気付ける原動力となったという…
strings.en:
Her strong spirit, never broken
by adversity, cheered her
comrades and became the
force that gave them all heart...

strings.jp:
多くの勝利に貢献したことから
戦の女神として彼女の名は後世まで
轟いたという…
strings.en:
Having helped win many
victories, she became known as
the goddess of war, and her
name rang out for ages...

strings.jp:
民兵の出身でありながら、多くの戦を
戦い抜いた彼女は帝国の民たちから
英雄として崇められたのだった…
strings.en:
Though from the militia, she
fought through many battles,
and the Empire's people revered
her as a hero...
